_note: Default config of StuppFKPPSolver: every parameter, the optional ones at the class defaults (tests/test_config.py checks that). Volumes are NIfTI paths relative to this file; the tissue maps are the reference_solves/ maps (182x218x182, 1 mm). rho and white_matter_diffusivity are the means of scripts/parameter_range.txt; the seed is the image center.
_volumes: resection_cavity ({"segmentation": <NIfTI path>, "label": <int>}) and rt_dose (Gy, TOTAL over all fractions) are null: no example segmentation and dose map ship with the repository yet, so this config does not run until they are given.
_clock: Times are days: t=0 is the tumor seed, the simulated growth before surgery is resection_time, the total simulated time is resection_time + time_after_resection.
_schedule: seed (day 0) --> resection (day 100) --> recovery (days 100-114) --> radiotherapy: 30 fractions on consecutive weekdays over 6 weeks (days 114-153, Monday = day 114); concomitant TMZ 75 mg/m^2 daily INCLUDING weekends over the same 6 weeks (days 114-155, 42 sessions) --> 4-week break --> adjuvant TMZ on days 1-5 of six 28-day cycles starting 4 weeks after the last fraction (day 181): days 181-185, 209-213, 237-241, 265-269, 293-297, 321-325; 150 mg/m^2 in cycle 1, 200 mg/m^2 in cycles 2-6 (72 sessions in total) --> growth to day 360 (35 days after the last dose).
_treatment: chemo_kill_rate (1/day per mg/m^2), chemo_decay_rate (1/day) and rt_alpha (1/Gy) are PLACEHOLDERS awaiting review. rt_alpha_beta_ratio is the linear-quadratic alpha/beta ratio in Gy (rt_beta = rt_alpha / rt_alpha_beta_ratio in 1/Gy^2 is derived by the solver and is not a config entry); 10 Gy is the class default.
